Since Our Founding

                                                                                                                                                                      Three Pledges

                                                                                                                                                                 Section   2
The firmly held philosophy of founder Yoshigoro Obayashi was clearly stated as the Three                                                                         Current Position and Value Creation Story
Pledges in the foreword to the Guidelines for On-Site Employees published in 1935 under the
second president, Yoshio Obayashi.                                                                                                                               Section   3
                                                                                                                                                                 Strategy Execution and
The foreword also stressed to employees the importance of honoring the Three Pledges not only                                                                    Non-Financial Value Enhancement
in terms of pursuing sustainable growth for the Company, but also for contributing to society.
They represent the single most essential principle for serving the nation and society. This spirit
                                                                                                                                                                 Section   4
                                                                                                                                                                 Corporate Governance Supporting
has been passed down to the present day, and is the foundation of the Obayashi Basic Principles.                                                                 Strategy Execution

                                                                                 Section   5
Steadfast Founding Values                                                        Data Section
Since its founding in 1892, we have earned the solid trust of clients
and society through its commitment to honest craftsmanship.
It represents our principle of doing business in a sincere and honest
manner, defining our brand and representing the DNA passed down
over many years.

                                                                                    Section   5
Our Strengths:                                                                      Data Section
Power of Vision, Power of Creation,
and Power of People
Our strengths derive from the power of vision to see beyond tomorrow,
the power of creation to transform ideas into tangible innovations,
and the power of people that makes everything possible.
These strengths are underpinned by solid technologies and honest
craftsmanship.
With these strengths as our foundation, we will continue to take on
new challenges and help shape the next era.

financial and non-financial capital as it works to address social and corporate sustainability issues through its business activities.

ESG-Related Material Issues
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Contents
The Obayashi Group has formulated Obayashi Sustainability Vision 2050 to pursue sustainability of the planet, society, and people, and of the Obayashi Group. We identified ESG-related material issues and built
a foundation to help resolve these social challenges. We promote sustainable growth and corporate value enhancement over the medium- to long-term by conducting initiatives to achieve our goals.

Medium-Term Business Plan                                                                                                                                                                    Obayashi Group Medium-Term Business Plan 2022

                                                                                                                                                                                               Addendum to Medium-Term Business Plan 2022    Contents
Medium-Term Business Plan 2022, formulated in March 2022, has entered its final year. As a direction for sustainable growth set out in the addendum to Medium-Term Business Plan 2022 announced in May 2024,
the Obayashi Group clearly states its aim “to establish a Group-wide business structure centered on the domestic construction business and in which other businesses generate performance equal to or greater than
that of the domestic construction business.” To achieve this, we are working to accelerate Company-wide transformation by strengthening the foundation of the construction business through three fundamental
strategies. In addition, we will achieve sustainable growth by expanding growth investments that capture opportunities and by increasing investment in human capital.                                                                        Section   1

   Feature                 Finance and Capital Strategy
         1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Contents



The Obayashi Group is targeting a return on invested capital (ROIC) of 5% or more over the medium term as a means of pursuing management with an emphasis on capital efficiency. Furthermore, in addition to
securing sustainable profit growth for each of its businesses while controlling invested capital, the Group has set the level of necessary equity at ¥1 trillion and is executing strategic shareholder returns as part of its
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Section   1
target to achieve a return on equity (ROE) of 10% or more by the final year of the current medium-term plan in FY2026. Through the steady execution of growth strategies, the Group aims to achieve sustainable profit                          Values and Vision for the Future
growth and further enhance corporate value.

Feature 2 Human Capital Strategy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Contents
Overview of Human Capital

In addition to an ever-changing business environment and advances in technological innovation, Obayashi Corporation is facing some complex issues in the human resources arena, including how to deal with an age-based
imbalance in the workforce and how to pass on its inherent commitment to honest craftsmanship. The Obayashi Group views human capital as the foundation for sustainable growth and seeks to advance human resources
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Section   1
management in line with its medium-term business plans. Regular employee engagement surveys and other initiatives have helped visualize the reality within the Group’s organization, prompting the introduction of a new                                                                                                                     Values and Vision for the Future
personnel system in FY2026. Under the new personnel system, the Group will define the talent portfolio required to realize its envisioned future business development and will advance its human capital strategy accordingly.

New Business Initiatives

The Obayashi Group seeks to build a solid business portfolio that can support sustainable growth by exploring new business initiatives beyond its existing
domestic and overseas construction, real estate development, and green energy businesses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                       Emerging Business Opportunities (EBO)                                                      Section   1
   In pursuing new business initiatives, the Group views the resolution of social challenges such as achieving carbon neutrality and well-being as its primary                                         New                                                                               Space    Values and Vision for the Future
mission and seeks to launch businesses in markets with medium- to long-term growth potential where the Group’s powers of vision, creation, and people                                                                                                                            Agriculture
can be fully leveraged. The specific process involves taking social challenges and megatrends into consideration and designating focus areas where the Group                                                                         Decarbonization
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     and
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                biotechnology     Section   2
can leverage its tangible and intangible assets, then making strategic investments and developing business through open innovation in each of those areas.

The Obayashi Philosophy is founded upon a commitment to value each person with a stake in our business. Striving to be a company that values every one of its associates, we are promoting initiatives to uphold
human rights in accordance with international standards such as the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Valuing Each Person with a Stake in Our Business                                                                                                                            Section   1
to Build a Sustainable Supply Chain                                                                                                                                         Values and Vision for the Future

As global demands regarding human rights increase, companies are expected to conduct responsible business activities not only internally but also across their supply
chains. The construction industry in particular conducts business in collaboration with a wide and diverse range of partner companies and relies on a diverse workforce,
                                                                                                                                                                            Section   2
including migrant workers. As such, effectively addressing human rights issues for everyone involved in the business is a key concern. The Obayashi Group also              Current Position and Value Creation Story
recognizes that the multilayered supply chains make it more difficult to identify human rights issues at lower tiers of the supply chain.
  For this dialogue, we invited Mr. Shoichi Ibusuki and Mr. Ryusuke Tanaka to exchange views with Shigeru Edatsune, Senior Managing Executive Officer of Obayashi           Section   3
Corporation and chair of the Supply Chain Management Expert Committee, and Koji Furuse, Managing Executive Officer of Obayashi Corporation and chair of the Human           Strategy Execution and
                                                                                                                                                                            Non-Financial Value Enhancement
Rights Expert Committee. They discussed initiatives to respect human rights, future challenges, and trends in Japan and overseas. Mr. Ibusuki is an attorney who has long
worked to address human rights issues affecting migrant workers and has represented such workers in labor disputes, while Mr. Tanaka works to promote international         Section   4
labor standards in the fields of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Business and Human Rights.                                                                    Corporate Governance Supporting

Social Contribution Activities                                                                                                                                                                                             Social Contribution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Contents



Obayashi’s corporate philosophy embodies its commitment to contributing to the realization of a sustainable society. To that end, we have formulated the Obayashi Social Responsibility Policy as one of the specific
measures designed to help achieve that aim. The policy focuses on four identified priority areas that will help bring about a sustainable society and that correlate closely with our business. As a good corporate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Section   1
citizen, we pursue social contribution activities in an effort to help solve social issues.                                                                                                                                                      Values and Vision for the Future
